description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the "Pass@1 Rate (%)" and the "Num. of Reasoning Steps" for two different models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Reasoning Steps," displays numeric values with specific tick marks placed at 5, 10, 20, and 40. The y-axis, labeled "Pass@1 Rate (%)," utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at regular intervals of 20. The plot features two solid lines representing the respective models. The line for GPT-4o is depicted in a medium blue color with solid circle markers, showing a continuous upward trend across the x-axis; it begins at a value of 6.5 at 5 reasoning steps, rises to 32.3 at 10 steps, increases further to 77.4 at 20 steps, and concludes at 83.9 at 40 steps. The line for Claude-3.5-Sonnet is shown in a lighter blue color with 'x' markers and also exhibits an upward trend; it starts at 19.4 at 5 reasoning steps, increases to 38.7 at 10 steps, experiences a sharp rise to 87.1 at 20 steps, and ends at a peak value of 89.2 at 40 steps.
